author: Trish Long, El Paso Times
title: El Paso pioneer recalls early days, says he brought alligators to San Jacinto Plaza
description: Adventures in San Jacinto Plaza, City Steals Carnegie Square, 'Cleaning Up the City' as told by El Paso pioneer J. Fisher Satterthwaite.
